controles.affirmation: Charge d'interets nette de 46,7 M$ au T2 2026, soit pres de 28% du resultat operationnel du trimestre (164,6 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: Interest expense 48.6 ; Interest income (1.9) ; Operating income 164.6 (10-Q T2 2026, compte de resultat). Net = 46,7 M$ = 28,4% de 164,6

controles.verbatim_source: China 19 % / 21 % (10-Q T2 2026, tableau de repartition geographique des ventes)

controles.affirmation: Le 10-K FY2025 mentionne pour la premiere fois des restrictions chinoises sur les materiaux et mineraux critiques, absentes du 10-K FY2024
controles.verbatim_source: ...impose export restrictions on raw materials and components, such as the restrictions imposed on critical materials and minerals by China in 2025... (10-K FY2025, Item 1A). Expression absente du 10-K FY2024 (depot 2025-02-12) : 0 occurrence.

controles.affirmation: Citation 'we have experienced increased and additional costs with respect to our import and export' attribuee au 10-Q T2 2026, Item 2 MD&A
controles.verbatim_source: 0 occurrence dans le 10-Q T2 2026. La phrase figure dans le 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : 'Because of the recent tariffs and other trade restrictions, we have experienced increased and additional costs with respect to our import and export of such materials, finished goods, and products'. Le 10-Q, lui, dit seulement : 'The imposition of tariffs and other trade measures (i) has increased, and may continue to increase, our sourcing and manufacturing costs'.
controles.correction_proposee: Reattribuer la citation au 10-K FY2025 Item 1A, ou la remplacer par le verbatim reel du 10-Q ('has increased, and may continue to increase, our sourcing and manufacturing costs'). La seconde citation ('difficult to quantify') et 'subject to ongoing litigation, legislative action, and further executive action' sont bien dans le 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: CA annuel 2025 : 3 196,6 M$ (-1,4%) ; resultat net annuel 2025 : 235,6 M$ (-19,5%)
controles.verbatim_source: For 2025, net sales were $3,196.6 million, decreased by $44.6 million, or 1%, from 2024 ; Net income was $235.6 million... compared to net income of $292.8 million... in 2024 (10-K FY2025). -1,4% et -19,5% exacts.

controles.affirmation: 7 700 employes fin 2025, soit -6,1% sur un an
controles.verbatim_source: As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 7,700 employees (10-K FY2025) ; 8,200 employees au 31/12/2024 (10-K FY2024). -6,1%.

controles.affirmation: 77,2% d'approbation lors du vote consultatif sur la remuneration a l'AG 2026, niveau sensiblement inferieur aux 90% habituels, signe d'un desaccord actionnarial plus marque que la moyenne
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 2026-05-08, Item 5.07, AG du 6 mai 2026, proposition 2 (advisory vote on Executive Compensation) : VOTES FOR 134,253,910 ; VOTES AGAINST 6,187,374 ; ABSTAINED 71,113 ; BROKER NON-VOTES 4,777,784. Taux d'approbation = 95,6% des voix exprimees (95,5% abstentions incluses ; 92,4% des actions representees ; 88,2% des actions en circulation). Aucun calcul ne donne 77,2%.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer l'affirmation et le raisonnement associe. Le say-on-pay 2026 a ete approuve a 95,6% des voix exprimees, soit un niveau NORMAL voire eleve, ce qui invalide entierement l'argument de 'desaccord actionnarial plus marque que la moyenne'. Corriger aussi la ligne de ce_qui_affaiblirait 'sous le seuil de 77,2%'. Verifier la source amont src/data/v2-pipeline/entg.json (governance.exec_comp_approval_pct = 77.2) qui est erronee.

controles.affirmation: Covenant de levier financier net maximal de 5,20x prevu par le contrat de credit amende
controles.verbatim_source: The Amended Credit Agreement contains a maximum first lien net leverage ratio covenant of 5.20 to 1.00, which is tested only when utilization of the Revolving Facility exceeds a specified threshold. Through June 27, 2026, the Company was in compliance... (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser 'levier net de premier rang (first lien)' et le fait que le covenant n'est teste que si le tirage du revolver depasse un seuil, sinon la contrainte parait plus large qu'elle ne l'est.
